meaning: The bridge STMT-BRIDGE-CHRISTS-CHURCH-FOUNDED-BY-GOD is derived, not assumed: given a God with the classical attributes who can reveal recognizably, Jesus' claim and resurrection, and a visible authoritative society c Jesus founded, the resurrection is that God's confirmation that Jesus holds his mandate (attestation); what God confirms is true, so Jesus holds it (veracity); c was founded in the exercise of that mandate and commissioned to teach (scope); and what a God's envoy so founds, that God founded as a teaching authority (envoy founding). Each premise is necessary (omissionModels) and the four are jointly satisfiable with every stage antecedent (jointModel). All four premises are open; the result closes the bridge only relative to them. The decisive premise is the scope premise: whether the attested mandate covers founding an institution with a teaching commission, and whether every society in the bridge's antecedent is the commissioned one.
